The wilting is rapid and complete, with leaves and stems hanging down and browning. This pattern of sudden, severe wilt in a single plant surrounded by healthy plants is characteristic of bacterial wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum), which causes vascular blockage leading to rapid whole-plant collapse.
